findings.title: Next's ProcessEnv augmentation made standalone configuration fixtures fail typecheck
findings.evidence: GitHub Actions 34516108593, job 103001806711: TS2345 in configuration fixture tests
findings.resolution: Configuration accepts a readonly string/undefined environment map instead of depending on framework-wide ProcessEnv augmentation.

findings.title: Packaging source into its own directory changed the directory while tar read it
findings.evidence: GitHub Actions 34516108593: tar returned file changed as we read it
findings.resolution: Use git archive on the exact checked-out commit; inspect all independent verification outcomes before the final CI gate.

findings.title: Installation reported dependency advisories requiring triage
findings.evidence: npm ci reported 6 moderate and 1 high advisory; exploitability and package identity not established yet
findings.next: Collect npm audit JSON and address material runtime issues; do not run an unreviewed force upgrade.
